title: The occult is behind the cover-up of giants

tellings.quote: I think the occult is behind the cover up of giants.

plain: The remains of giants are being hidden, and the occult, meaning secret mystical groups or practices, is behind that hiding. Tim Alberino, who comes on the podcast to talk about a twelve-foot giant he says was captured in Afghanistan, states this as his own belief and does not give a source for it.
